head: ee77d8df8c9cb6638d788bc4b11c8da4048addcd
note: The online line now refreshes every 30 seconds through a new /live/now endpoint, and the page reloads at once when the screen comes back; the wiring looks sound, with one small staleness gap.

points.what: During the 5-minute quota backoff, onlineNow() returns the old cached answer without throwing. /live/now then sends it without stale:true, so the top line drops the 'נתון אחרון שנשמר' label even though the number may be minutes old.
points.fix: In the /live/now handler, add stale: Date.now() - onlAt >= 20e3 (or Date.now() < backoffUntil) to the successful response.
